[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 120
- Description: SunMint plots registry + impact map integration (Rancho Maranta)
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/844
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/truesight_me_beta/pull/325
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint/commit/279d208
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sunmint/commit/a06a710d8cfde6a228036ef7caeaa92fbffa2713
  
  Details:
  Established the SunMint plots registry and wired the impact map to it, following the governor's brief to document Jedielcio's two plots (Rancho Maranta, Altamira/PA) using the existing tech ecosystem.
  
  Deliverables:
  1. **GPS extraction from media (no video frame decoding)** — exiftool on HEIC/MOV container metadata. Plot 1 (house): -3.29610,-52.58316 (matches TREE PLANTING EVENT -3.29609,-52.58318). Plot 2 (family ~5 ha): walk track -3.2934..-3.2947, -52.5768..-52.5789 (23 MOV clips, hull ≈2.9 ha < 5 ha claimed → CAR/INCRA recommended).
  2. **Runbook** — agentic_ai_context/SUNMINT_PLOTS_REGISTRY.md (PR #844, merged): process for defining/extending plots, boundary authority tiers, schema, do/don't.
  3. **Seed registry** — sunmint/plots/index.geojson (RM-P1 planted, RM-P2 proposed polygons).
  4. **Impact map wiring** — truesight_me_beta PR #325 (merged): PILOT_CENTER → Altamira, plots fetch from plots/index.geojson, hectares popup, fitBounds, satellite cell guard (no Florianópolis overlay).
  5. **Generator + workflow** — sunmint/scripts/build_plots_geojson.py (reads "SunMint Plots" sheet tab; preserves curated seed if tab missing) + .github/workflows/rebuild-plots-index.yml.
  
  Context: PoDream/DreamCarbon UAV inventory is PAUSED/red-flagged (Onaya handoff 2026-08-30) — this integration deliberately uses the phone-first GPS + Sentinel-2 pattern, not drone inventory.
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
